column1: # tools/css/gen-condition-tables.py: what the pinned webref `@media` descriptors do not say, for each media feature of the pin. One row per feature, tab separated:
#  1 name     the feature as webref spells it (it must be in the pin; a row the pin does not have is a stale row)
#  2 unit     the family of its value: length (px against the environment), ratio, resolution (dppx; `infinite`), integer, number, mq-boolean (0 or 1), keyword
#  3 field    the member of GTEXT_CSS_Media_Environment (include/ghoti.io/text/css/css_media.h) that it reads; the gate looks the member up in that header
#  4 dep      what a change of the environment that invalidates it is: viewport, device, resolution, color, display, input, scheme, preference, environment, extension
#  5 status   implemented (evaluated here) | parse-only (parsed and serialized, always unknown)
#  6 note     the sentence of the served text that decides what the row does, or the reason for the status

column6: Media Queries 4, 4.1: the width of the viewport, including a scroll bar
Media Queries 4, 4.3: the ratio of width to height
Media Queries 4, 4.4: portrait when height >= width, else landscape
Media Queries 4, 5.1: false in the negative range; infinite is larger than any resolution
Media Queries 4, 6.1: bits per color component, 0 for a device with no color
Media Queries 4, 6.4: each gamut implies the smaller
Media Queries 4, 7.1: the primary pointing device
Media Queries 4, 7.3: true when any available device has the value
Media Queries 4, deprecated: the width of the rendering surface of the device
Media Queries 5, 6.6: each gamut implies the smaller
Compatibility Standard, 4.3: a number of device pixels per CSS pixel, a range feature; false in the negative range
CSS Round Display 1, 4: rect or round
Window Management: the state of the window
Window Management: whether the window can be resized
